Hi Quinn,

Thank you for reaching out regarding invoice #60685.

Per our billing policy, a licensed seat is tallied for any user who was active (logged in or invoked API resources) during the billing month. User deactivations take effect at the start of the next billing cycle, which is why your active count today may differ from the total billed seats for that period.

To ensure our finance team can review your invoice accurately, could you please provide:

1. A list or export (CSV) of user accounts or emails you believe were incorrectly billed.
2. The specific billing month in question.

Once we receive this information, we will audit the activity logs and review eligibility for an account credit.

Best regards,
Billing Support
